title: Endoscope Dryer / Storage Cabinet
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY MEDICAL COMMAND.US ARMY HEALTH CONTRACTING ACTIVITY.W40M MRCO EAST
detail_text: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT A MARKET SURVEY FOR WRITTEN INFORMATION ONLY. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION ANNOUNCEMENT FOR QUOTES AND NO CONTRACT WILL BE AWARDED FROM THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. NO REIMBURSEMENT WILL BE MADE FOR ANY COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH PROVIDING INFORMATION IN RESPONSE TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT OR ANY FOLLOW-UP INFORMATION REQUESTS. The U.S. Army Health Contracting Activity (USAHCA) Health Readiness Contracting Office, Medical Services Branch, Fort Belvoir VA intends to award a Firm-Fixed Price, Purchase Order for 1 Each Endoscope Dryer / Storage Cabinet in accordance with the attached specifications for delivery to Keller Army Community Hospital, West Point, NY. This solicitation will be prepared in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) Part 12 Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. The NAICS code is 339113 (Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing) and the size standard is 800 employees. The PSC is 6515. Responses to this sources sought announcement will be used by the Government to make appropriate acquisition planning decisions.
